Post-treatment care depends on the procedure, but here are general tips:

**After Cleaning/Checkup:**
• Avoid eating for 30 minutes
• Mild sensitivity is normal for 24 hrs

**After Whitening:**
• Avoid tea, coffee, colored foods for 48 hrs
• Use sensitivity toothpaste

**After Root Canal/Extraction:**
• Soft foods for 2-3 days
• Take prescribed medicines on time
• Avoid hot beverages for 24 hrs

I can help you compare treatments! Common questions we get:

🔄 **Aligners vs Braces** — Aligners are invisible & removable; braces handle complex cases better
🔄 **Veneers vs Bonding** — Veneers last 15+ years; bonding is quicker but less durable
🔄 **Implant vs Bridge** — Implants are permanent & don't affect adjacent teeth
🔄 **Whitening vs Veneers** — Whitening for stains; veneers for shape + color

The best option depends on your specific case. Dr. Siddharth can give you a personalized recommendation during a free consultation!
